changes.title: Pad swap
items: On a gamepad, □ now uses and places (stations, sigils, runes) and ✕ takes off and lands; in menus ✕ still chooses and ○ goes back

changes.title: Stumps per area
items: The great stumps are on: every area's runestone is now a giant old tree stump, lit by the sigils above it
Each kind of area has its own stump, from its own main tree, in its bark and on its ground
Stand on the middle of the stump to cast the soundsystem spell
Stumps are drawn as you come near, so islands load as fast as before

changes.title: Great stumps
items: Every area's runestone is now a giant old tree stump, a different tree in each biome, its roots spreading 25 m
The sigils floating over a stump light it in their colours
The music's ring sits on the stump's cut
